SELECT id, `name`, `code`, `description`, `enable`, module_id FROM bp_equipment_station WHERE is_deleted = 0
and `name` like concat('%',#{name},'%')
and `enable` =#{enable}
and module_id in
#{item}
and code like concat('%',#{code},'%')
order by code asc

SELECT t2.`name` as moduleName, t2.`code` as moduleCode, t1.`name` as name, t1.`code` as code, t1.`description` as `description`, t1.id as id, t1.`enable` as `enable` FROM bp_equipment_station AS t1 JOIN bp_factory_module AS t2 ON t1.module_id = t2.id WHERE t1.is_deleted = 0 AND t2.is_deleted = 0 and t1.id =#{id}
